items.title: A cocontinuous continuous fully faithful functor gives a subtopos with a retraction

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a functor between sites which is cocontinuous, continuous and fully faithful, the two canonical maps relating the functors g_!, g^{-1}, g_* of the associated morphism of topoi are isomorphisms (statement lines 4879-4893). The proof is a complete computation: the composite of the pullback with the pushforward is a limit indexed by pairs of objects whose morphisms need not come from the site, and full faithfulness identifies the indexing category with one having an initial object, giving the identity (proof lines 4896-4909); the composite of the pullback with the left adjoint is treated in the same way as a colimit, and the author repeats the argument for the plus construction to obtain the identity after sheafification (proof lines 4912-4934). The non-formal content is the reduction of the limit and colimit to the identity pair. The claim is H2: a computation carried out twice with the same mechanism.
